A changed label gains one glyph after its acting cursor cell, not at row end.

NEOVIM
Which hidden path is required?
M15.APPH.P01.compact_prompt:
ANIMATION: local append.
NEOVIM: retrieve a.
M15.APPH.P01.animation_answer: One glyph follows the cursor cell.
feedback: Correct: the hidden review preserves ordinary a scope.
No: A targets the row end.
No: block append is not this local action.
No: ~ toggles case.

M15.APPA.P01.source_ref: Authored ordinary append contrast; Neovim help A
M15.APPA.P01.prompt:
ANIMATION
A glyph appears at the true end of the hi row while earlier cells remain unchanged.

NEOVIM
Which append command owns row-end scope?
M15.APPA.P01.compact_prompt:
ANIMATION: final glyph added.
NEOVIM: choose A.
M15.APPA.P01.animation_prompt: Only the row end gains one glyph.
M15.APPA.P01.neovim_prompt: Which path appends at row end?
M15.APPA.P01.neovim_answer: Use A, type the glyph, and Escape.
choices: ANIMATION: row end gains glyph | NEOVIM: ggfhA!<Esc>
ANIMATION: after cursor gains glyph | NEOVIM: ggfha!<Esc>
ANIMATION: full row replaced | NEOVIM: cw
feedback: Correct: uppercase A enters append at the row end.
No: a inserts beside the current glyph rather than at the final rail.
No: cw is word change.
No: J merges rows rather than extending the right edge.

M15.APPAH.P01.source_ref: Authored changed ordinary A-append review; Neovim help A
M15.APPAH.P01.prompt:
ANIMATION
The changed label gains one final glyph and no middle cell shifts.

NEOVIM
Which hidden method is required?
M15.APPAH.P01.compact_prompt:
ANIMATION: final glyph added.
NEOVIM: retrieve A.
M15.APPAH.P01.animation_prompt: The appended glyph is at the true row end.
M15.APPAH.P01.animation_answer: Existing label cells remain in place.
feedback: Correct: retrieve ordinary A, not block append.
No: a keeps the current cursor location instead of reaching the changed row end.
No: block append has a rectangular selection.
No: J combines rows; ordinary A must append to this row alone.
